title: 01. Fundamentals: COPY, DEEPCOPY & OBJECT CLONING
summary: COPY, DEEPCOPY & OBJECT CLONING: SHALLOW COPY vs DEEP COPY; Shallow Copy: copies outer container, shares inner objects.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/copy_deep.py
import copy

# ============================================================
# SHALLOW COPY vs DEEP COPY
# ============================================================

# --- Shallow Copy: copies outer container, shares inner objects ---
original = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], {"key": "value"}]

shallow = copy.copy(original)
# or: shallow = original.copy()
# or: shallow = list(original)
# or: shallow = original[:]

shallow[0].append(999)     # Modifies shared inner list!
print(original[0])         # [1, 2, 3, 999] — ALSO CHANGED!

shallow.append([7, 8, 9])  # Only affects shallow (outer change)
print(len(original))       # 3 (unchanged)
print(len(shallow))        # 4

# --- Deep Copy: copies EVERYTHING recursively ---
original = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], {"key": "value"}]
deep = copy.deepcopy(original)

deep[0].append(999)
print(original[0])  # [1, 2, 3] — NOT changed!

# --- Custom copy behavior ---
class Config:
    def __init__(self):
        self.settings = {"debug": True}
        self.db_connection = "live_connection"  # Don't copy this!
    
    def __copy__(self):
        new = Config.__new__(Config)
        new.settings = self.settings.copy()  # Shallow copy settings
        new.db_connection = None              # Don't copy connection
        return new
    
    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        new = Config.__new__(Config)
        memo[id(self)] = new  # Handle circular references
        new.settings = copy.deepcopy(self.settings, memo)
        new.db_connection = None
        return new

# --- When to use which ---
# Assignment (=):   Same object, no copy
# Shallow copy:     New container, shared contents. Use for flat data.
# Deep copy:        Everything new. Use for nested mutable data.
```
